sentences.ar: لما وصل، لقى جو وهَك قاعدين عالشط، وزعلانين.
sentences.en: When he arrived, he found Joe and Huck sitting on the shore, upset.
Joe said: I read the bark.
We thought you had run off and left us.
Tom said: I am the Black Pirate.
I do not leave my men.

sentences.ar: وحكى لهم عن الليل، والبكا، والجنازة.
sentences.en: And he told them about the night, the crying, the funeral.
And he said: I have an idea.
But I am not telling it yet.
And Joe said: I want to go home.
And Tom said: only until Sunday.
Trust me.
And that same night, the storm came.

sentences.ar: بالأول ريح، وبعدين برق، وبعدين رعد زي المدافع.
sentences.en: First wind, then lightning, then thunder like cannons.

sentences.ar: والمطر نزل زي إنه النهر انقلب عليهم من فوق.
sentences.en: And the rain came down as if the river had been turned over on them from above.

sentences.ar: ركضوا للخيمة اللي عملوها من الشرشف، والريح أخدت الشرشف.
sentences.en: They ran to the tent they had made from the sheet, and the wind took the sheet.

sentences.ar: ركضوا للشجرة الكبيرة، والبرق ضرب الشجرة.
sentences.en: They ran to the big tree, and the lightning struck the tree.
They ran to the cave, and sat in it.
Shaking, and soaked to the bone.

sentences.ar: وطول الليل، البرق بيضوي الجزيرة زي النهار، وبعدين عتمة.
sentences.en: And all night, the lightning lit the island like day, and then darkness.
And in the morning, everything was calm.

sentences.ar: طلعوا من المغارة، والجزيرة صارت إشي تاني.
sentences.en: They came out of the cave, and the island had become something else.

sentences.ar: شجر مكسور، وأغصان بكل مكان، والنار راحت.
sentences.en: Broken trees, branches everywhere, and the fire gone.

sentences.ar: والشجرة الكبيرة اللي ناموا تحتها أول ليلة، مشقوقة نصين.
sentences.en: And the big tree they had slept under the first night, split in two.
Huck said: if we had been under it.
And no one finished the sentence.

sentences.ar: ولقوا جمرة تحت الرماد، وشعلوا النار، ونشفوا، وأكلوا.
sentences.en: And they found an ember under the ashes, lit the fire, dried off, and ate.

sentences.ar: وبعد الأكل، توم قال: هلق بحكي لكم الفكرة.
sentences.en: And after eating, Tom said: now I tell you the idea.

sentences.ar: وحكاها، بصوت واطي، زي إنها سر حرب.
sentences.en: And he told it, in a low voice, as if it were a secret of war.

sentences.ar: وجو صار يضحك، وهَك صار يضحك، وقالوا: هاي أحسن فكرة بالدنيا.
sentences.en: And Joe began laughing, and Huck began laughing, and they said: this is the best idea in the world.
And Joe said: so we go back on Sunday?
Tom said: Sunday.
But not the way they expect.
